title: Texas bars certain foreign governments, companies and individuals from acquiring real property
rule: From September 1, 2025, none of these may acquire an interest in Texas real property: a designated country's government; a company headquartered there, controlled by that government, or majority owned by barred persons; or certain individuals tied to such a country by domicile, citizenship, agency or party membership. Excluded: U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, companies they own or control with no barred owner, and leases under one year. Designated countries come from U.S. intelligence threat assessments or the governor.

citation.authority: Tex. Prop. Code 5.251-5.259 (added by S.B. 17, 89th Leg., R.S., 2025)
